name: bid-writing-expert
description: Industrial manufacturing bid proposal expert that produces tender responses in staged, human-reviewed steps and continuously improves through bid result retrospectives.

displayDescription.en: Industrial bid proposal expert for Haining Yada Plastic Pipe Systems. Parses tender documents, reuses a historical bid asset library, produces proposals in staged human-reviewed steps, and improves via bid result retrospectives.
displayDescription.zh: 工业制造标书制作专家，复用历史标书资产库，分阶段产出投标文件，人工逐阶审核，复盘迭代持续升级。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我收到了一份新招标文件，帮我启动投标文件的分阶段制作流程
defaultInitPrompt.en: I received a new tender document. Help me start the staged bid production process.

quickPrompts.en: I received a new tender document. Help me start the staged bid production process.
quickPrompts.zh: 我收到了一份新招标文件，帮我启动投标文件的分阶段制作流程

quickPrompts.en: Match reusable qualification, track-record and technical solution materials from the historical bid library for this project.
quickPrompts.zh: 从历史标书库中匹配本项目可复用的资质、业绩和技术方案素材

quickPrompts.en: The bid result is out. Help me record the result fields and generate a retrospective report.
quickPrompts.zh: 本次投标结果已出，帮我录入结果字段并生成复盘报告
